title: muhlenbergia thurberi
intro: Muhlenbergia thurberi, commonly known as Thurber's muhly or Thurber's wild grass, is a perennial grass native to the southwestern United States and northern Mexico. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Muhlenbergia thurberi include its ability to promote wound healing, reduce pain and swelling, and exhibit antimicrobial activity. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
